calculation.formula: SUM(IF [event_type] = "Unsubscribe" AND [event_timestamp] >= [Parameters].[Start Date] AND [event_timestamp] <= [Parameters].[End Date] AND ([Parameters].[Program Type Filter] = "All" OR [program_type] = [Parameters].[Program Type Filter]) AND ([Parameters].[Direction Filter] = "All" OR [direction] = [Parameters].[Direction Filter]) AND ([Parameters].[Country Filter] = "All" OR [country] = [Parameters].[Country Filter]) AND ([Parameters].[Company Size Filter] = "All" OR [company_size] = [Parameters].[Company Size Filter]) AND ([Parameters].[Product Filter] = "All" OR [product] = [Parameters].[Product Filter] OR ([Parameters].[Product Filter] = "" AND ISNULL([product]))) THEN [event_count] END)
